name: Solra
blurb: Sparkling yuzu, a little salt, no sugar. Solra runs its campus launch through student reels and sells the 12-pack it films.

name: Notely
blurb: Paper for people who type all day. The Five Minute Journal in linen, and the chalk drops that put it on the quad the night before launch.

name: Vera
blurb: Going-out clothes and the Friday pop-ups that sell them. Vera staffs its own door with students who work the line.

name: Axelerate Beauty
blurb: Clinical K-beauty brought to US campuses. Axelerate Beauty places Dermabell in local salons and stocks the glass skin serum behind the counter.

name: Loop
blurb: One box, one common room. Loop ships the demo kit and pays the student who fills the room.

name: August Uncommon Tea
blurb: Loose-leaf blends with a story per tin. Southern Gothic — peach and a whisper of bourbon smoke — is the one that got it on campus.

name: Italic
blurb: Turkish cotton woven in Denizli, sold without the hotel markup. Three towels, sized for a shared bathroom.
